PLAN "Full Integrated Plant-Based Muscle Gain Plan Summary (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "12-week structure: progressive plant-based muscle gain with cardio and a weekly cheat meal"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 1 Upper/Lower - Week 1":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Phase 1 Lower - Week 1":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 1 Upper/Lower - Week 2":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..9 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Phase 1 Lower - Week 2":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          stiff_legged_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Phase 2 Upper - Week 1":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Tuesday training 65m "Phase 2 Lower - Week 1":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          elliptical 10 minutes
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Phase 3 Upper - Week 1":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          preacher_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          swimming 8 minutes
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Tuesday training 70m "Phase 3 Lower - Week 1":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 15 minutes
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5 minutes
    CHEAT_MEAL_DAY:
      DAY Sunday cheat_meal 0m "Cheat Day (Weekly)">
        notes:
          - "One refeed-style day to support adherence and long-term progress."
          - "Maintain protein targets ~0.8–1.2 g/kg; avoid excessive ultra-processed foods."
          - "Hydration, fiber, electrolytes important; balance with energy intake."
          - "Enjoy cravings; include a protein-forward meal elsewhere to hit daily protein target."

NUTRITION GUIDANCE
  - Target daily protein: 150 g from plant-based sources.
  - Protein distribution: aim for 25–40 g per meal where possible.
  - Post-workout nutrition: within 1–2 hours, ~20–40 g protein plus carbs.
  - Hydration: water to thirst; electrolyte beverages around intense days.
  - Plant-based protein powder options (canonical names only): pea_protein, rice_protein, soy_protein, hemp_protein, mixed_plant_protein, brown_rice_protein, pumpkin_seed_protein.
  - Breakfasts, snacks, and meals should align with vegan dietary preferences.

CARDIO PLAN SUMMARY
  - Phase 1: short cardio windows per session (10–15 minutes); modes include cycling, walking, brisk walks.
  - Phase 2: moderate cardio blocks 10–12 minutes; occasional longer options.
  - Phase 3: maintain cardio for recovery and conditioning; occasional higher-intensity sessions as tolerance allows.

NOTES
  - All exercises use canonical names from allowed vocabulary.
  - Maintain progressive overload; adjust loads to keep target RPE.
  - Safety first; substitutions available if any exercise causes discomfort.
  - Cheat day is weekly on Sundays with protein-forward planning to maintain targets.

PLAN "Post-Workout Meal Suggestions for a Plant-Based Muscle Gain Client"
TYPE guidance
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Provide plant-based post-workout meal options to support muscle protein synthesis and recovery"

PHASES
  PHASE "Guidance" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday guidance 0m "Post-Workout Nutrition Options":
        main_notes:
          - "Aim for a meal containing around 0.3–0.5 g protein per kg body weight and 0.5–1.0 g carbohydrate per kg body weight within 1–2 hours post-workout."
          - "Protein sources should total ~150 g protein/day; distribute evenly across meals."
          - "Hydration: 20–40 g of water-soluble micronutrient-rich options as desired; rehydrate with electrolytes if training was intense."
          - "Protein options (plant-based, canonical names only):"
            - "protein shake: plant_protein_powder (20–30 g protein) + water or fortified plant milk"
            - "tofu scramble: tofu 150–200 g + vegetables + olive oil"
            - "lentil bowl: cooked lentils 1 cup + quinoa 0.5 cup + veggies"
            - "tempeh stir-fry: tempeh 150 g + rice 1 cup + veggies"
            - "edamame: shelled edamame 1.5 cups"
            - "chickpea salad: chickpeas 1 cup + greens + dressing"
          - "Carbohydrate options (canonical names):"
            - "rice"
            - "quinoa"
            - "oats" (as part of a smoothie bowl or oats with toppings)
            - "bread" (whole grain)
            - "potato" (baked or boiled)
            - "pasta" (whole wheat or legume-based)
          - "Fat sources (modest amounts):"
            - "olive_oil"
            - "almonds" (a small handful)
            - "walnuts"
            - "avocado"
          - "Example post-workout meals (adjust portions to protein target and energy needs):"
            - "Protein shake 1 scoop plant_protein_powder + 250 ml fortified plant milk + 1 banana + 1 tbsp peanut_butter"
            - "Tofu scramble with vegetables + 1 cup cooked quinoa"
            - "Lentil bowl with 1 cup cooked lentils, 0.5 cup cooked quinoa, veggies, and olive oil"
            - "Chickpea salad wrap using whole_grain_bread or tortilla with greens and tahini sauce"
            - "Tempeh stir-fry with 150 g tempeh, 1 cup cooked rice, mixed vegetables, and sesame oil"
          - "Hydration: water or electrolyte drink as needed; avoid excessive caffeine immediately post-workout if sensitive."

PLAN "Protein Powder Recommendations for Plant-Based Client"
TYPE guidance
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Guide plant-based protein powder selection for muscle gain"

PHASES
  PHASE "Guidance" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday guidance 0m "Protein powder recommendations":
        main_notes:
          - "Consider plant-based protein powders that provide complete amino acid profiles and ~20–30 g protein per serving."
          - "Options by protein source (canonical names only):"
          - "pea_protein"
          - "rice_protein"
          - "soy_protein"
          - "hemp_protein"
          - "mixed_plant_protein"  (blend of multiple sources)
          - "brown_rice_protein" (use if available as canonical name; otherwise rice_protein)
          - "pumpkin_seed_protein" (if available)
        guidance:
          - "For best appetite and muscle protein synthesis, choose a blend that includes at least 20–25 g protein per scoop and a complete amino acid profile (ideally with 2–3 g leucine)."
          - "Soy_protein is a complete protein; if tolerating soy, 20–30 g per serving is effective."
          "Digestibility varies: start with 1 scoop and assess tolerance."
        example_recommendations:
          - "Plant_protein_blend: mix of pea_protein + rice_protein + another plant source to achieve complete amino acid profile"
          - "Soy_protein: 1 scoop (20–25 g protein) with water or fortified plant milk"
          - "Pea_protein + hemp_protein blend for balanced amino acids"
        cautions:
          - "Check for added sugars or excessive artificial ingredients."
          - "Allergies: ensure no allergen cross-contamination if sensitive."
        notes:
          - "If client desires vegan whole-food alternatives, pair a protein shake with a legume-based main meal to meet daily protein target."
